answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit bond in three ledgers. The basalt ledger holds a 30-credit stake, locked one epoch and burned on fraud. The mesa checkpoint requires one job bound by hash to its key; reuse burns the stake. A relic record forms after three peers attest the answer; it cannot transfer. The kth fake needs 90 credits, one mesa job, and attestations, so 1,000 fakes cost 90,000 credits, 1,000 jobs, and 3,000 attestations. An honest agent pays 90 once and recovers it. Rented attestations fail: the relic record mismatches attester keys with its key and burns bonds.
